title: asset.setProperty response result
description: Acknowledgement of an asset.setProperty request. Values are snapshot copies, never references into engine live memory. Rejection is returned as an error response with code ENGINE_ASSET_EDIT_REJECTED and an English message. Its data object contains string fields 'method' (asset.setProperty) and 'reason' (for example type_mismatch, out_of_range, unknown_property, or unknown_asset), and a string 'path' field only when applicable.

previousValue.description: Snapshot copy of the value before the change.

appliedValue.description: Optional snapshot copy of the value actually applied, which may be normalized from the requested value.
